scenario.name: Signalised intersection with cross traffic
scenario.description: The vehicle approaches a signalised intersection; the signal is hard to read, dark or meant for another lane, or a crossing vehicle runs its red

events.description: Enters the intersection on red into crossing traffic

triggers.condition: Low sun or oncoming headlights in a camera's view
LED signal heads that flicker against the camera's exposure
Signal heads that are hidden, damaged, temporary, dark in a power outage, or meant for another lane
A vehicle running a red light or not stopping at its stop line

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.meant: waits while its path is crossed
scenario.pass: The vehicle enters only on a recognised green and treats an unknown signal as red; whatever the signal, it does not enter when its swept path crosses that of a detected road user before it could stop or clear

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 8.4 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

parameters.parameter: Speed of the crossing vehicle running the red
parameters.range: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed
parameters.label: Speed of the crossing vehicle running the red: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: waits while its path is crossed
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-06.1 Enters the intersection on red into crossing traffic
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
